patch.value: Surface optional package requirements for maintenance command routes

Reproduction with the pinned CLI and a fresh real PM workspace: GET pm/comments-audit and POST pm/normalize return HTTP 200 with an unknown_command error requiring pm-governance-audit; POST pm/reindex with mode keyword returns HTTP 400 requiring pm-search-advanced. The default package provides these UI actions without provisioning or capability guidance for their newly optional providers. Covered through real HTTP/PostgreSQL in test/pm-command-access.test.ts. Follow-up: expose provider availability and actionable install guidance, preserve all authorization and refusal paths, and use appropriate non-success status for a refused operation. Optional package provisioning and UI capability migration are outside the route coverage task pm-web-ulgy.

Fresh workspaces expose which maintenance actions require optional providers; Unavailable actions return an actionable documented non-success response without modifying tracker state; Real HTTP and PostgreSQL tests cover provider availability and preserve authorization and CSRF refusals
